items.title: Nvidia confirms $13 billion acquisition of open-weight AI platform Hugging Face
items.summary: Nvidia will pay roughly $13 billion to acquire the open-weight AI platform Hugging Face, the company confirmed on Thursday.

items.title: Why Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face is an 'important strategic move'
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) will be buying open-weight AI company Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to discuss what this means for Nvidia's standing in the AI ecosystem as it aims to become more than just a chip supplier.

items.title: AI has become a 'non-negotiable', Sam Altman says at G20 summit
items.summary: Big Tech CEOs convened in North Carolina to speak at the G20 summit on Wednesday, laying out the virtues and benefits of AI to world leaders. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley discusses OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman's comments at the event.

items.title: This One Metric Is Why I’m Going to Keep Buying Nvidia Hand-Over-Fist
items.summary: One stubborn number buried in Nvidia's latest earnings report signals something that almost never survives at hardware scale, and it is the reason this investor keeps adding shares despite a valuation that looks stretched on the surface.

items.title: SEMI’s CEO Has Watched Four Decades of Chip Cycles. He Says This One Only Goes Up.
